content.title: Social media stocks slide as OpenAI launches Sora 2 model and video generation app
content.summary: Investing.com -- OpenAI on Tuesday unveiled Sora 2, its next-generation video and audio generation model, which the AI leader says represents a major leap in realism, physical accuracy, and controllability. Launched through a dedicated iOS app, Sora 2 arrives with the ability to synchronize dialogue and sound effects, while introducing users to immersive, AI-generated simulations that realistically adhere to the laws of physics.

content.title: Why Snap (SNAP) Stock Is Nosediving
content.summary: Shares of social network Snapchat (NYSE: SNAP) fell 6.6% in the afternoon session after Mizuho initiated coverage on the company with a Neutral rating. Mizuho set a $9 price target and described the company as a "show-me story." The investment firm expressed caution, citing weak feedback from Snap's advertising channels.
